name: Dual Transform
author: Andrew Plotkin; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
description: One room, but not always the same one, and one object with more to it than it seems. Experiment. Text adventure in English (Andrew Plotkin, 2010). Non-commercial licence. Type if-dual-transform in the Terminal or tap the icon.
